mapper.sql: select application_id, visitor_id, host_id, host_name, start_time, end_time, reason, status, approve_time, create_time, update_time from visitor_application
mapper.select:
select u.user_id, u.nick_name as name, d.dept_name, u.email from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by u.user_id limit 20

select u.user_id, u.nick_name as name, d.dept_name, u.email from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'

select count(1) from visitor_application where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and status = '2' and approve_time is not null and approve_time >= curdate() and approve_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
mapper.update: update visitor_application set status = #{status}, approve_time = #{approveTime}, update_time = sysdate() where application_id = #{applicationId} and status = '0'
